thesis: Order of Leitbur gave white aggressive decks a flexible two-drop whose pump, first strike, and protection from black let mana translate into favorable combat.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The Order became a defining Fallen Empires Knight and a staple of White Weenie, while its mirrored rivalry with Order of the Ebon Hand captured the set’s factional identity.

playbook.role: Leave white mana available when first strike or toughness changes the exchange, but keep curving out when the pump is only cosmetic. Protection makes the Order a specialized threat against black removal and blockers.
